proposal.description: fault_LED's UVLO indication is masked unless the converter is in S_SS or S_RUN. This borrows fault_cause's 'a routine power-down asserts UVLO' capture rule, but the LEDs must show what is wrong now, in every state.
proposal.reason: With UVLO_trig asserted while the supervisor is in S_OFF or S_HICCUP, for example at power-up on a low input rail, Red_LED3 stays dark instead of lighting. A UVLO that hits in S_RUN lights it for only one clock before the FSM leaves S_RUN.

proposal.description: The switch-press pulse is suppressed while the host enable is still set, as if it were only needed to lift a veto already in place. reg_file's rule that the physical switch wins a same-clock collision with a host disable is lost.
proposal.reason: When the debounced switch rises on the same clock that a validated CONTROL disable commits, spi_enable is still 1, so the press is masked and the disable lands. The converter stays off (En low, STATUS bit 5 clear) instead of the press keeping it enabled.

proposal.description: pgood_gen's 'regulating' qualifier also drops on the RUN window trip. The aim is to hand the rail back the moment an overcurrent is detected, but PGOOD should follow the supervisor's exit from S_RUN.
proposal.reason: On a RUN overcurrent window trip, PGOOD and switch_supply fall on the trip clock, one clock before the supervisor leaves S_RUN for S_HICCUP, and the qualifying count is cleared a clock early.

proposal.description: The overcurrent window trips are folded into fault_LED's running indication, a second path that fault_LED's header deliberately leaves out because the supervisor's state change already turns off the green LED.
proposal.reason: On a soft-start or RUN window trip, Green_LED turns off one clock earlier than when it follows the supervisor's exit to S_HICCUP.
